name: Voltas Ltd.
business_summary: Tata Group air-conditioning and projects company. Unitary cooling products (room ACs, commercial refrigeration; ~80% of Q1 FY27 revenue) is India's top room-AC brand (17.3% secondary share, FY27 to June). Electro-mechanical projects (MEP, water, rail; ~15%) and engineered products/ Voltas Beko (appliances JV with Arcelik) and an Atomberg JV announced in Q1. EBITDA margin only ~4% TTM, so profits are hypersensitive to copper, USD/INR, discounting and summer weather. Legacy Qatar project litigation is a tail liability.

exposures.mechanism: Copper ~8% and aluminium ~3% of total costs (RAC BOM ~25% metals; UCP ~80% of sales). +10% copper => +0.8% costs; costs/EBITDA ~24x at 4% margin => EBITDA -19%; ~70% recovered via price hikes => -6%; persistence 0.35, EV/MCap ~1.0 => -2.1.

evidence.note: AC/TV/appliance price hikes of up to 8% from 1 Oct on copper, aluminium, freight; Blue Star +8%, LG +5-7%, Daikin +8-10% from 16 Sep
Q1 FY27: rev Rs4,674cr (+18.7%), PAT Rs213cr (+51%), UCP rev +32% to Rs3,794cr, UCP EBIT 5.3%, RAC volume +45%, 1m units in 81 days, secondary share 17.3%

exposures.mechanism: Aluminium ~3% of costs; +10% => +0.3% costs => EBITDA -7%, ~70% recovered, persistence 0.35 => -0.7. Aluminium is -19.6% since June: a tailwind to H2 costs.

evidence.note: AC/TV/appliance price hikes of up to 8% from 1 Oct on copper, aluminium, freight; Blue Star +8%, LG +5-7%, Daikin +8-10% from 16 Sep

exposures.mechanism: Imported compressors and electronics ~25-30% of costs (USD-priced). +3% USD/INR => +0.8% costs => EBITDA -20%; ~60% passed through => -8%; persistence 0.4 => -3.2. Pack empirical is +2.87 (t=1.6), opposite sign; it likely co-moves with the USD/CNY channel below and risk-on episodes. Treated as low-medium confidence.

evidence.note: screener.in pack: fundamentals, price performance, empirical betas

exposures.mechanism: Chinese components/compressors ~20% of costs; yuan -3% vs USD makes imports cheaper (cost -0.6%, EBITDA +15% unpriced, +6% after pass-through, persistence 0.35 => +2.1) and eases competitor Chinese-sourced costs equally. Pack empirical +7.29 (t=3.1) is large and significant; model shrinks toward mechanism but accepts a high upper bound. Note the pair with USD/INR: a pure USD move raises INR cost, a CNY-only depreciation lowers it.

evidence.note: screener.in pack: fundamentals, price performance, empirical betas

exposures.mechanism: Room AC is ~80% of Q1 revenue; +5pp urban growth => revenue +3.5%, at 4% margin and ~25% contribution => EBITDA +20% unpriced, x persistence 0.4 => +3 (operating leverage dominates). Q1 FY27 UCP revenue +32% on +45% RAC volume shows the sensitivity.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27: rev Rs4,674cr (+18.7%), PAT Rs213cr (+51%), UCP rev +32% to Rs3,794cr, UCP EBIT 5.3%, RAC volume +45%, 1m units in 81 days, secondary share 17.3%

exposures.mechanism: +1pp category margin give-up on UCP (80% of sales) => group margin -0.8pp vs 4.0% TTM base => EBITDA -20% x persistence 0.35 => -7, shaded to -6. Voltas states it is prioritising share over margin (Sep 2026 analyst meet), which makes it the most exposed name; Goldman (Sell, target Rs1,075) cites margin headwinds.
